title.full: Who can opt out of CareShield Life

summary.text: It depends on your age, citizenship or residency, and how you joined CareShield Life.

details.heading: Born in 1980 or later
details.body: If you are a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident born in 1980 or later, you cannot opt out. CareShield Life is mandatory for you.

details.heading: Born 1970 to 1979
details.body: If you were automatically enrolled in 2021, you could opt out by 31 December 2023. You cannot opt out after that date.

details.heading: You chose to join
details.body: If you chose to join CareShield Life, you can opt out during the 60-day free-look period from your cover commencement date. You cannot opt out after that period.

details.heading: New citizens or permanent residents
details.body: If you became a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident from 1 October 2020 onwards, were born in 1979 or earlier, and have not developed severe disability, CareShield Life is mandatory.

sources.page_title: Can I opt-out from CareShield Life?

quotes.text: Please select the age group you belong to.
If you are a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident born in 1980 or later, CareShield Life will be universal and mandatory for you. You will not be able to opt out.
You will not be able to opt-out from CareShield Life after 31 December 2023.
You will not be able to opt-out from CareShield Life after the 60 days free-look period.

If you are a foreigner who become a Singapore Citizen or a Permanent Resident from 1 October 2020 onwards, is born in 1979 or earlier and have not developed severe disability, CareShield Life will be mandatory for you.
